2.w: “Surround unto me a little, and I will show you, that [there are] words yet to God.

3.w: I will lift up my knowledge from afar, and to my Maker I will ascribe righteousness.

4.w: For truly, my words [are] not false; the one complete in knowledge [is] with you.

5.w: Behold, God [is] mighty, and He does not despise; [He is] mighty [in] strength of heart.

6.w: He does not keep the wicked alive, and He gives justice to the afflicted.

7.w: He does not take away His eyes from the righteous, but [they are] with kings on the throne; and He has seated them forever, and they are exalted.

8.w: And if they are bound in the fetters, caught in the cords of affliction,

9.w: then he declares to them their work and their transgressions, because they magnified themselves.

10.w: And He opens their ear to correction, and He says that they should turn back from iniquity.

11.w: If they do hear and serve, they will complete their days in good, and their years in pleasantness.

12.w: And if they do not obey, by a weapon they shall pass away, and they shall die as without knowledge.

13.w: And the godless of heart set the nose; they do not cry out when He binds them.

14.w: Their soul dies in youth, and their life among the male shrine prostitutes.

15.w: He rescues the afflicted one by his affliction, and uncovers their ear by oppression.

16.w: And indeed He has drawn you from the mouth of distress, [into] a broad place without constraint under it, and the resting of your table is full of richness.

17.w: And you are filled [with] the judgment of the wicked; judgment and justice take hold—

18.w: for wrath, lest it entice you with mocking, and a large bribe not let it stretch you.

19.w: Can your opulence make arrangement in time of distress, or all the forces of strength?

20.w: Do not long for the night, for the coming up of peoples in place of them.

21.w: Take heed not to turn to iniquity, for upon this you have been chosen by affliction.

22.w: Behold, God is exalted in His power; who [is] a teacher like Him?

23.w: Who has appointed for Him His way? Or who has said, ‘You have done unrighteousness’?

24.w: Remember that you should magnify His work, of which men have sung.

25.w: Every man has gazed on it; mankind looks on [it] from afar.

26.w: Behold, God [is] great, and we do not know [Him], and [there is] no searching the number of His years.

27.w: For He draws up drops of water; they distill as rain from the mist,

28.w: which the clouds pour down; they drop upon man in abundance.

29.w: Indeed, if one will understand the spreading out of a cloud, the noises [from] His pavilion?

30.w: Behold, He scatters His lightning around Him, and covers the depths of the sea.

31.w: For by these He judges the peoples; He gives food in abundance.

32.w: With [His] palms He covers the lightning, and He gives a charge upon it for [its] striking.

33.w: [By] its shouting He declares concerning it, the cattle also concerning the arising.
